projection.ddl: pragma journal_mode=delete; create table entities(entity_id text primary key,kind text not null,payload_json text not null,event_id text not null,event_sequence integer not null default 0); create table relations(relation_id text primary key,relation_type text not null,source_id text not null,target_id text not null,payload_json text not null,event_id text not null,event_sequence integer not null default 0); create table records(record_id text primary key,record_kind text not null,payload_json text not null,event_id text not null,event_sequence integer not null default 0); create table datoms(datom_id text primary key,origin_id text not null,subject text not null,attribute text not null,value_json text not null,value_kind text not null,event_sequence integer not null,event_id text not null); create table projection_meta(meta_id text primary key,ledger_head text,ledger_sequence integer not null,updated_event_id text); insert into projection_meta(meta_id,ledger_head,ledger_sequence,updated_event_id) values('current',null,0,null); create index datoms_subject_attribute on datoms(subject,attribute); create index datoms_attribute_value on datoms(attribute,value_json); create index datoms_sequence on datoms(event_sequence,event_id);

source_inspect.containment: paths must canonicalize inside the site root

guidance.requested_echo: the emitted object also carries requested:{workflow,tool} echoing the caller's routing hints (null when absent)

extension_relation_rule.text: Any relation outside core_relations must be namespaced, for example marici:refines or marici:generalizes.

extension_entity_kind_rule.text: Any entity kind outside entity_kinds must be namespaced, for example cintamani:experiment or cintamani:equipment_type. Extension kinds carry their full structured record in additional payload fields; the version/locator requirement applies only to the source kind.

fields.purpose: Preserve evolving problem situations, not certify truth.

workflow.why: Perform the ordinary submit, preserved policy review, and admission workflow atomically. Omit expected_ledger_head to snapshot the current head and omit idempotency_key for deterministic retry safety.
Create a reviewable source proposal when manual review before admission is intended; operations may be empty for pure source capture.
Persist a reviewable proposal without source batching.
Use separate calls only when the operator wants an explicit pause between proposal, review, and admission.
Verify the admitted problem situation and its relations.

communication_model.legacy_write_remediation: Use narada.epistemic:communication. Domain entity kinds must be namespaced; unqualified domain kinds are schema defects, not synonyms.
communication_model.compatibility_lifetime: normalize_and_disclose until a ledger-head-bound audit proves zero legacy entities and writers; disable only through an authorized contract-version transition
communication_model.rule: Communication records provenance and argumentative causality, but does not become epistemic evidence unless a separate reviewed promotes_to_evidence relation is admitted.
communication_model.delivery_boundary: The epistemic graph is append-only communication provenance; mailbox delivery and read state remain separate. One communication has one mechanically admitted recipient; broadcasts use one record per recipient or explicit addressed_to relations.

sequence_workflow.why: Create a named Site-owned numeric authority once; start_at defaults to 1.
Claim one permanent number using a unique idempotency key for the claim intent.
Verify current allocation state or audit bounded immutable claims.

sequence_semantics.authority: Separate immutable coordination records under .narada/epistemic/sequences; not epistemic assertions or graph events.
sequence_semantics.claim: Permanent, monotonic, increment-by-one, never released or reused.
sequence_semantics.formatting: The authority returns unsigned integers; callers own prefixes, padding, and display formatting.

identity_rule.relations: Omit relation_id to derive it deterministically from relation_type, source_id, and target_id. Supply an override only when parallel duplicate relations are intentional.
identity_rule.idempotency: Omit idempotency_key for deterministic content-hash retry identity; supply one only to name a wider caller-defined retry scope.

revision_pattern.entity_title_correction: Declare a successor entity with the corrected title and connect it to the prior entity using supersedes. Keep the prior identity as immutable history.
revision_pattern.discovery: Query or inspect the predecessor neighborhood before declaring the successor.
revision_pattern.reason: The graph is append-only; revision is explicit explanation, not silent record mutation.

provenance_choices: Represent a document as a versioned source entity and connect claims with derived_from.
For an assessment or test outcome, include evidence entries with source_id, locator, and paraphrase.
Do not manufacture an assessment merely to attach provenance; conjecture plus derived_from is valid.
fields.concurrency_rule: Omit expected_ledger_head to snapshot the live head during submission while retaining CAS protection through admission. Supply a concrete status.ledger_head only when an external read must be the concurrency boundary. If review reports stale, query again and submit a new proposal; do not rewrite the immutable proposal.
fields.search_boundary: Use external providers for discovery. Record a sweep only when it explains coverage or changes the graph.
fields.problem_policy: Transform apparent solutions into successor problems; record closure only as an attributed assessment.
